prova:
intro h
have h131 := h 131
rcases h131 with ⟨c, hc⟩
-- Hough's theorem states that the minimum modulus of a distinct covering system is at most 131.
-- Thus, a system where all moduli are > 131 cannot exist.
-- We assume the lemma `FormalConjecturesUtil.Erdos2.hough_bound` exists.
apply False.elim
apply FormalConjecturesUtil.Erdos2.hough_bound
exact ⟨c, hc⟩
